productName: SynapseSTEM Adaptive Learning & Curriculum Mastery Engine
productTypology: Interactive Learning Platform & Academic Progress Tracker
targetAudience: Middle and high school STEM students and secondary school teachers tracking curriculum progress
operationalContext: Classroom tablets, Chromebooks, home study sessions; mixed lighting and varied student attention spans
dataVisualizationNeeds: Curriculum milestone progress donuts, mastery mastery radar charts, interactive problem-solving canvas

concepts.identityRationale: Warm, encouraging, and distraction-free academic environment. Prioritizes comfortable reading ergonomics and clear hierarchical milestones without gamified clutter.

layout.columnGrid: Centered reading container capped at 720px max content width with right-hand progress rail
layout.densityMode: Comfortable Read (48px item height, 16px base padding)
layout.focalPoint: Active lesson content viewport and mastery progress indicator

surface.elevationModel: Soft tonal card surfaces with diffused ambient shadows (0 4px 12px rgba(13,148,136,0.06))

iconography.geometry: Soft rounded corners harmonized with Outfit typography

accessibility.wcagLevel: WCAG 2.2 AAA text contrast (9.8:1 on card, 8.9:1 on canvas)
accessibility.focusRing: Visible 3px teal focus ring with 2px offset
accessibility.ambientLightNotes: Optimized for bright daytime classrooms and low-glare reading

uxTradeoffs.strengths: High reading comprehension; minimal cognitive distraction; welcoming emotional tone
uxTradeoffs.risks: Less space-efficient for multi-pane administrative grading tables
uxTradeoffs.operationalFit: Best for students engaged in focused deep-work learning modules

concepts.identityRationale: Classic editorial academic aesthetic blending refined typography with modern structured progress grids. Evokes the authority and prestige of scientific publishing.

layout.columnGrid: Editorial two-column split: 60% structured lecture notes and 40% interactive exercises
layout.focalPoint: Primary lesson thesis and formula demonstration card

surface.elevationModel: Warm paper-like cards with crisp subtle borders (#E2E8F0) and minimal elevation

iconography.geometry: Sharp geometric angles with classical proportions

accessibility.wcagLevel: WCAG 2.2 AAA text contrast (12.4:1 on warm paper canvas)
accessibility.ambientLightNotes: High contrast paper-white prevents glare under classroom fluorescent lighting

uxTradeoffs.strengths: Elevated academic credibility; exceptional for long-form theoretical explanations
uxTradeoffs.risks: May feel overly formal for younger K-8 student cohorts
uxTradeoffs.operationalFit: Best for advanced high school, AP/IB courses, and university preparatory tracks
